snippet.title: The Magician's Hand - GamePlay Trailer
snippet.description: Set in Victorian London, this moody atmospheric puzzle platformer, you play as the severed hand of the mysterious Magician Fabrizio. Waking up with no memory, only a nagging urge to uncover the truth. Brave, curious, and drawn to adventure, hand grows along the journey, discovering his inner strength and a few unexpected gifts.   Embarking on this adventure with perspective-shifting mini games and distinctive boss battles. You need find Fabrizio before it is too late!    Steam - PC        #indiegame #action
